questions.question: What percentage of students were fully immunized at 10th Street School for the 2014-15 school year?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('wadoh_school_immunization.csv')
school = df[df['School_Name'] == '10TH STREET SCHOOL']
result = float(school['Percent_complete_for_all_immunizations'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Across all reporting schools, were more students exempt from pertussis vaccination than from polio vaccination?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('wadoh_school_immunization.csv')
pertussis = df['Number_exempt_for_pertussis'].sum()
polio = df['Number_exempt_for_polio'].sum()
result = 'yes' if pertussis > polio else 'no'
